class.name: NNAgent
class.brief_description: Root node for a utility AI agent that scores and runs behaviours.
class.description: Drives a utility AI entity. Add [NNSensor] nodes to gather inputs and [NNBehaviour] (or [NNBehaviourGroup]) nodes to define the options the agent can choose from. On each thinking step, the agent scores its behaviours from their considerations, picks one, and steps through its child [NNAction] nodes. By default the agent updates automatically on physics frames according to [member process_thread] and throttles decision-making with [member tick_rate] while still ticking the active behaviour and action every frame. Set [member process_thread] to [constant MANUAL] if you want to drive it yourself with [method tick], or nest it under a state, action, or HTN task to let that host drive it. Use [member current_behaviour_bias] to keep the agent from rapidly oscillating between similarly scored behaviours, and [member num_behaviours_to_select] to pick weighted-randomly among the top candidates for more varied behaviour. The agent provides the [NNBlackboard] and actor context for all Noodle Nodes children beneath it.

constants.constant: Updates automatically on physics frames. This is the default.
Disables automatic updates so your own code can call [method tick] or [method auto_tick_step].

method.name: abort_current_behaviour
method.description: Immediately stops the active behaviour and action, even if [member NNBehaviour.can_be_interrupted] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: auto_tick_step
method.description: Runs one scheduled step using the same enabled checks and [member tick_rate] throttle as automatic ticking. Returns [code]true[/code] if the agent stepped. Useful for custom schedulers and deterministic tests.

method.name: evaluate_options
method.description: Updates enabled sensors, scores enabled behaviours, and selects a behaviour if the current one is no longer among the top [member num_behaviours_to_select] candidates. Skipped while the active behaviour has [member NNBehaviour.can_be_interrupted] set to [code]false[/code].

method.name: get_current_action_node
method.description: Returns the currently running [NNAction], or [code]null[/code] if none is active.

method.name: get_current_behaviour_group_node
method.description: Returns the [NNBehaviourGroup] of the currently selected behaviour, or [code]null[/code] if none is active or it is ungrouped.

method.name: get_current_behaviour_node
method.description: Returns the currently selected [NNBehaviour], or [code]null[/code] if none is active.

method.name: get_random_seed
method.description: Returns the seed used when picking among top-scoring candidate behaviours.

method.name: set_random_seed
method.description: Sets a fixed seed for candidate selection when [member num_behaviours_to_select] is greater than [code]1[/code], making choices reproducible.

method.name: tick
method.description: Runs one full step immediately: updates cooldowns, calls [method evaluate_options] and [method update_current_behaviour], and emits [code]frame_tick[/code] on active nodes. Use with [constant MANUAL] mode.

method.name: update_current_behaviour
method.description: Advances the active behaviour to the next action if the current action finished, or ends the behaviour if no actions remain or an action failed.

members.member: Optional actor [Node] this agent acts for. When unset, [method NoodleNodes.get_actor] inherits from the nearest ancestor root or falls back to this node's parent.
Optional [NNBlackboard] resource for this agent. When unset, inherits from the nearest ancestor root or creates a private blackboard automatically.
Score bonus added to the currently running behaviour before ranking candidates. Positive values reduce oscillation by making the agent stick with its current behaviour longer.
Name of the currently running behaviour, or empty if none is active.
Number of top-scoring behaviours kept as candidates. A value of [code]1[/code] deterministically picks the highest scorer; higher values pick randomly weighted by score when switching behaviours.
Controls when the agent ticks automatically ([constant PHYSICS], [constant IDLE], or [constant MANUAL]). Ignored when the agent is hosted under another AI node.

How often the agent re-evaluates behaviours. A value of [code]N[/code] runs thinking every [code]N[/code]th step (default [code]6[/code], roughly 10 times per second at 60 FPS), while [code]frame_tick[/code] still runs every step.
Name of the highest-scoring behaviour from the last evaluation, or empty if none scored above [code]0.0[/code].
Duration in microseconds of the last [method evaluate_options] call (debug builds only).
Duration in microseconds of the last [method update_current_behaviour] call (debug builds only).

signal.name: action_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the active action changes, or with [code]null[/code] when no action is running.

signal.name: action_exited
signal.description: Emitted when the active action is cut short because the behaviour changed, was aborted, or had no candidates left.

signal.name: behaviour_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a new behaviour is selected, or with [code]null[/code] when the running behaviour finishes or is aborted.

signal.name: behaviour_exited
signal.description: Emitted when the active behaviour is replaced by another behaviour or no valid candidates remain.

signal.name: behaviour_group_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a new behaviour is selected, passing its parent [NNBehaviourGroup] or [code]null[/code] if ungrouped.

signal.name: behaviour_group_exited
signal.description: Emitted when the agent switches away from the active behaviour group or has no valid candidates left.
